proposed_fix.description: First capture a heap profile of checkoutservice to find the leaking allocation path. Then do a rolling restart of the checkoutservice pods to reclaim memory, and set or tighten memory limits with an OOM alert. Fix the leak (e.g., unbounded caches or retained request objects in PlaceOrder) and redeploy.
